text: A courier must visit eight clients in one day. Each client is available only during a stated two-hour window, and the travel time between every pair of clients is given. Some early choices of order make later windows impossible to reach. Give an order of visits that reaches every client within their window.

In a small warehouse grid, three crates must be pushed onto three marked squares. A crate can only be pushed, never pulled, and a crate pushed into a corner can never be moved again. The grid, the crates and the worker's starting square are given. Give a sequence of pushes that puts every crate on a marked square.

A house renovation has twelve jobs. Some jobs must finish before others start, the crew can work on only two jobs at once, and the plasterer is available only on days three to six. All durations and orderings are given. Give a schedule that finishes the renovation in fourteen days.
